title: U-series and ESR analyses of bones and teeth relating to the human burials from Skhul
bibliographicNote: Read the published abstract. It gives 100–135 ka under a short-burial-span assumption and does not exclude an older age for Skhul IX. The chapter uses the approximate 130–100 ka summary in Groucutt et al. (2018), explicitly as a synthesis range rather than an exhaustive confidence interval.
